([[College Park, Georgia]]) | college = * [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont]] (2021–2022) * [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]] (2022–2025) | highlights = * [[List of NCAA Division I men's basketball champions|NCAA champion]] ([[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2025]]) * [[Ohio Valley Conference|OVC]] All-Newcomer team (2022) }} '''Will Richard''' (born December 24, 2002) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. He previously played for the [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont Bruins]]. ==Early life and high school== Richard grew up in [[Fairburn, Georgia]] and attended the [[Woodward Academy]].{{Cite web |date=2025-04-08 |title=Former Woodward Academy standout Will Richard wins national championship with Florida |url=https://www.wsbtv.com/news/local/former-woodward-academy-standout-will-richard-wins-national-championship-with-florida/UYSVEGZUWBHMVJNW3VBXW6XLQI/ |access-date=2025-04-09 |website=WSB-TV Channel 2 - Atlanta |language=en}} Coming out of high school, he committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont Bruins]].{{cite web |last1=Sugiura |first1=Ken |title=Woodward Academy grad Will Richard has become a transfer-portal magnet |url=https://www.ajc.com/sports/georgia-tech/woodward-academy-grad-will-richard-has-become-a-transfer-portal-magnet/UQI6XSVEM5EBPNR3D3TH4UH2W4/ |website=The Atlanta Journal-Constitution |access-date=March 8, 2025}} ==College career== === Belmont === In the first round of the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament]], Richard notched 22 points and eight rebounds in a loss to [[2021–22 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]].{{cite web |last1=Organ |first1=Mike |title=Belmont basketball's Will Richard transferring to Florida |url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/2022/04/09/richard-transferring-florida-gators-belmont-basketball/9529964002/ |website=The Tennessean |access-date=March 8, 2025}} As a freshman in 2021-22, he averaged 12.1 points and 6.0 rebounds per game while shooting 32.6 percent from three,{{cite web |last1=Redman |first1=Bob |title=High-profile Belmont transfer Will Richard goes in depth with why he chose Florida |url=https://guidetogreatergainesville.com/high-profile-transfer-will-richard-chooses-florida-gators/ |website=Guide to Greater Gainesville |access-date=March 7, 2025}} earning [[Ohio Valley Conference]] all-newcomer team honors. After the season, Richard entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].{{cite web |last1=Carroll |first1=Brandon |title=Scouting Report: Florida Gators Transfer Guard Will Richard |url=https://www.si.com/college/florida/basketball/florida-gators-basketball-transfer-portal-guard-will-richard-scouting-report |work=Florida Gators on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 7, 2025}} === Florida === Richard transferred to play for the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]].{{cite web |last1=Thompson |first1=Edgar |title=Coming off Will Richard’s game-winner, No. 5 Gators gear for Georgia |url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/2025/01/24/florida-gators-mens-basketball-georgia-bulldogs-sec-todd-golden-mike-white-will-richard/ |website=Orlando Sentinel |access-date=March 7, 2025}} In 2022-23, he made 30 starts out of 32 games played, averaging 10.4 points and 4.5 rebounds while shooting 39.8 percent from 3-point range in his first season as a Gator.{{cite web |last1=Brockway |first1=Kevin |title=Another Florida basketball guard testing NBA Draft waters on same day UF lands Top 50 commit |url=https://www.gainesville.com/story/sports/college/football/2024/04/17/florida-basketball-guard-will-richard-declares-for-nba-draft-with-option-to-return/73303186007/ |website=Gainesville Sun |access-date=March 7, 2025}} On February 24, 2024, Richard dropped 21 points and five threes in a win over [[2023–24 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]].{{cite web |last1=Brockway |first1=Kevin |title=How Will Richard lifted Florida basketball to win over Vanderbilt |url=https://www.gainesville.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2024/02/24/florida-gators-basketball-tops-vanderbilt-commodores/72626945007/ |website=Gainesville Sun |access-date=March 7, 2025}} During the 2023-24 season, he made 35 starts, averaging 11.4 points and 3.9 rebounds per game while shooting 34.5 percent from three.{{cite web |last1=Brockway |first1=Kevin |title=Starting guards Walter Clayton Jr., Will Richard returning to Florida basketball |url=https://www.gainesville.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2024/05/27/florida-basketball-guards-walter-clayton-jr-will-richard-returning-for-2024-25/73821502007/ |website=Gainesville Sun |access-date=March 7, 2025}} On December 29, 2024, Richard totaled 26 points, five rebounds, two steals and two assists in a win over [[2024–25 Stetson Hatters men's basketball team|Stetson]].{{cite web |title=Richard scores career-high 26 to boost No. 7 Florida to 12-0 |url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/2024/12/21/florida-gators-sec-basketball-todd-golden-walter-clayton-alijah-martin-stetson-hatters-ncaa-basketball/ |website=Orlando Sentinel |access-date=March 7, 2025}} On February 25, 2025, he notched 30 points in a loss to [[2024–25 Georgia Bulldogs basketball team|Georgia]].{{cite web |last1=Parker |first1=Cam |title=Will Richard Passes Horford, Noah on Florida's All-Time Scoring List |url=https://www.si.com/college/florida/basketball/will-richard-passes-horford-noah-on-florida-s-all-time-scoring-list-01jnbxcem1zg |work=Florida Gators on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 7, 2025}} On March 1, Richard put up 25 points on nine of 13 from the field in a win over [[2024–25 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]].{{cite web |last1=Thompson |first1=Edgar |title=No. 3 Gators ride Will Richard’s hot hand past No. 12 Texas A&M |url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/2025/03/01/florida-gators-mens-basketball-sec-texas-am-aggies/ |website=Orlando Sentinel |access-date=March 7, 2025}} In the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|national championship game]], Richard scored 18 points, including all four of his three-pointers in the first half, in a close, come-from-behind 65-63 win over [[2024–25 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]]. ==Personal life== Richard is the son of Al and Helen Richard.{{cite web |title=2024-25 Men's Basketball Roster |url=https://floridagators.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/will-richard/16878 |access-date=5 April 2025}} He is a [[Christianity|Christian]].{{cite web |last1=Claybourn |first1=Cole |title=Will Richard helps Florida on Final Four run, hopes people see his career is 'all God' |url=https://sportsspectrum.com/sport/basketball/2025/04/03/will-richard-florida-final-four-all-god/ |website=Sports Spectrum |access-date=6 April 2025}} == References == {{reflist}} ==External
